(rule!
 ;; Blue cells fall independently to the bottom of their columns.
 ;; A line clear removes all completely blue rows, preserving the order of
 ;; other rows and adding black rows at the top. The episode fixes the order.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (fall x)
       (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c)
         (let ((cnt (count-where (lambda (rr) (= (at x rr c) 1)) (range h))))
           (if (>= r (- h cnt)) 1 0)))))
     (define (clear x)
       (let* ((kept (filter
                     (lambda (row)
                       (< (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 1)) row) w))
                     x))
              (lost (- h (length kept))))
         (append (for/list ((i (range lost))) (make-list w 0)) kept)))
     (clear (fall g)))))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define (columns x)
     (map (lambda (c) (count-where (lambda (r) (= (at x r c) 1)) (range h))) (range w)))
   (define (pack cs)
     (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (>= r (- h (list-ref cs c))) 1 0))))
   (define (top-pack cs)
     (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (< r (list-ref cs c)) 1 0))))
   (define (fall x) (pack (columns x)))
   (define (full-row row) (= (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 1)) row) w))
   (define (full-at r) (full-row (list-ref g r)))
   (define (clear-near x)
     (let* ((kept (filter (lambda (row) (< (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 1)) row) (- w 1))) x))
            (lost (- h (length kept))))
       (append (make-list lost (make-list w 0)) kept)))
   (let* ((counts (columns g))
          (k (count-where full-row g))
          (m (apply min counts)))
     (let ()
       (define (subtract n) (map (lambda (v) (max 0 (- v n))) counts))
       (pack (subtract (if (> m 0) 7 0))))))))
